# SCI-MAP v0.2/r0.3 requirement crosswalk

Status: candidate traceability aid; no implementation, validation, freeze, or
production claim. Canonical wording lives in the six common LaTeX modules.
Section names are navigation aids and do not create a second authority.

| Requirement | Scientist-facing source | Engineering interpretation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| SCI-MAP-REQ-001 | `notation.tex`; all three physical covers and Document authority | Record contract v0.2 and document r0.3 separately in every view and artifact; bind exact owner, source, directive, entry, build, status, and date identities under the exact shared/formal/rationale/ECS role hierarchy. |
| SCI-MAP-REQ-002 | Rationale: What SCI-MAP estimates; `definitions.tex` quantity | Accept only the exact realized positive-rank PTC transformed product and beam/unit parent; reject CAL fallback, disabled/no-product routes, and Stokes promotion. |
| SCI-MAP-REQ-003 | Rationale: From samples to pixels; `definitions.tex` occurrence identity | Join by complete stable occurrence and generation, never container, row, time, or coordinate equality. |
| SCI-MAP-REQ-004 | Rationale: From samples to pixels; producer/consumer flow | Preserve PTC producer facts, PTC QC, MAP admission, VAL evaluation, causes, and generations as distinct records; record the six r0.3 profile/approval/registration/binding/evaluation/object-decision axes without asserting a current evaluation. |
| SCI-MAP-REQ-005 | Rationale: From samples to pixels; Projection, response, and removed modes | Bind same-`n` AST coordinates and apply only the one-hot half-open MAP projection. |
| SCI-MAP-REQ-006 | Rationale: What SCI-MAP estimates; exact uniform binding block | Require explicit admitted-family selection and complete exact handoff; preserve historical exact uniform approvals while the new candidate Registry/source generation and object decision remain pending/unavailable; apply independent MAP numerical classification with no default or fallback. |
| SCI-MAP-REQ-007 | Rationale: Coverage, support, and validity; exposure equations | Deduplicate stable originals and place each once by its own AST original-footprint coordinate and target WCS. |
| SCI-MAP-REQ-008 | Rationale: Projection, response, and removed modes; response equations; comparison-space specification | Disclose the known MAP-local operator; separately classify fixed, full-procedure, re-resolved, coadd-procedure, and whole-chain families; bind `SCI-MAP-FULL-PROCEDURE-COMPARISON-SPACE` before every numerical procedure difference; keep coadd-procedure and whole-chain responses separately unavailable. |
| SCI-MAP-REQ-009 | Rationale: Units, WCS, products, and downstream use | Keep requested, effective, observation-resolved, applied, and realized state one-way; record attempt outcome separately; an applied failure or authorized no-support attempt has no realized product. |
| SCI-MAP-REQ-010 | Rationale: From samples to pixels; gate equations | Evaluate typed gates in the ordered DAG, project only exact passing states, and classify before arithmetic. |
| SCI-MAP-REQ-011 | Rationale: From samples to pixels; ordinary accumulator equations | Accumulate numerator, normalization, and matching response over exactly the admitted positive contribution set. |
| SCI-MAP-REQ-012 | Rationale: From samples to pixels; support-row selection equations | Publish normalized scientific values only on exact authorized finite-positive rows; unsupported rows are absent, not zero, and an empty authorized row set produces no product. |
| SCI-MAP-REQ-013 | Rationale: Weights and uncertainty | Keep numerator and normalization roles distinct from sky estimate, precision, exposure, coverage, and significance. |
| SCI-MAP-REQ-014 | Rationale: What SCI-MAP estimates; input-class predictions | Verify constant preservation only on the exact fixed support-row domain and do not promote it to stronger response claims. |
| SCI-MAP-REQ-015 | Rationale: Projection, response, and removed modes | Keep one-hot containing-pixel projection as the exact estimator family; reject fractional/WLS substitution. |
| SCI-MAP-REQ-016 | Rationale: Projection, response, and removed modes; operator and procedure equations | Bind and disclose one exact row-selected MAP operator for signal and every named linear companion; authorize any procedure subtraction only through the complete common-domain and both-row-map record. |
| SCI-MAP-REQ-017 | Rationale: Projection, response, and removed modes; comparison-space specification | Call a kernel realized response only with exact template, sample parent, family, state, support rows, lineage, and, for full-procedure differences, every identity/gauge/support/perturbation/comparison field. A state delta alone does not authorize subtraction. |
| SCI-MAP-REQ-018 | Rationale: Projection, response, and removed modes | Apply no MAP/coadd signal centering and preserve upstream removed-mode state. |
| SCI-MAP-REQ-019 | Rationale: Weights and uncertainty; covariance equation | Propagate only the declared exact-domain covariance and preserve every incomplete or unavailable term honestly. |
| SCI-MAP-REQ-020 | Rationale: Weights and uncertainty; formal-weight equations | Call normalization inverse variance only when coefficient and independence premises and projection identity all hold. |
| SCI-MAP-REQ-021 | Rationale: Weights and uncertainty; formal-weight equations | Compute and label formal diagonal weight separately from normalization, covariance precision, exposure, hits, and empirical weight. |
| SCI-MAP-REQ-022 | Rationale: Weights and uncertainty; approved OD-004 | Persist actual uncertainty/covariance meaning, domain, assumptions, omissions, limits, state, and lineage without zero fill. |
| SCI-MAP-REQ-023 | Rationale: Weights and uncertainty; conditionality statement | Label response/covariance conditional when state is data-derived; require a separate joint model for unconditional claims. |
| SCI-MAP-REQ-024 | Rationale: Weights and uncertainty; SCI-NOI terminology amendment | Keep Q, formal conditional precision, complete conditional covariance, NOI conditional marginal second moment, NOI standardized signal, and any future significance method distinct; allow only the exact claim authorized by the NOI method. |
| SCI-MAP-REQ-025 | Rationale: Coverage, support, and validity | Store geometric, route, contribution, count, two exposure, two support, and MAP-validity facts separately. |
| SCI-MAP-REQ-026 | Rationale: Coverage, support, and validity | Evaluate geometric incidence, route candidacy, and estimator contribution over their distinct populations. |
| SCI-MAP-REQ-027 | Rationale: Coverage, support, and validity | Count only exact contribution-set members and retain the distinct cause for every exclusion. |
| SCI-MAP-REQ-028 | Rationale: Observation coaddition | Count complete admitted observation bundles per row, not sample hits or attempts. |
| SCI-MAP-REQ-029 | Rationale: Coverage, support, and validity; exposure equations | Form upstream-eligible exposure from exact eligible ancestors using each original's own coordinate, before coefficient/MAP numerical rejection. |
| SCI-MAP-REQ-030 | Rationale: Coverage, support, and validity; exposure/coadd equations | Form retained and coadd exposure from admitted ancestor unions without duplicating originals or interpreting seconds as precision. |
| SCI-MAP-REQ-031 | Rationale: Coverage, support, and validity; threshold equations; override record | Preserve the exact population/order statistic, including `Q_star=0` for `N=0` without a selected element or zero-sky meaning, and every reached cut stage; bind the typed above-one override and the selected no-support `not_produced` outcome. |
| SCI-MAP-REQ-032 | Rationale: Coverage, support, and validity; threshold equations; small-N fixtures | Validate the observation-resolved cut before application, bind the applied value at the event, and use it for both inclusive thresholds; finite-positive normalization remains mandatory and support has no stronger physical meaning. |
| SCI-MAP-REQ-033 | Rationale: Coverage, support, and validity | Compute MAP-local validity only for an actual realized product from its exact required facts; empty support has no product validity; limited response/covariance alone does not invalidate or promote a realized base product. |
| SCI-MAP-REQ-034 | Rationale: From samples to pixels; ordered gate flow | Retrieve only structurally admitted payloads, classify them safely, and complete every gate before arithmetic. |
| SCI-MAP-REQ-035 | Rationale: Coverage, support, and validity | Keep zero, low-positive, negative, non-finite, and out-of-grid causes distinct with their exact contribution behavior. |
| SCI-MAP-REQ-036 | Rationale: Observation coaddition; role dependency matrix | Construct a base-observation bundle only for actual rows/product; independently bind each role and exact response family; distinguish unavailable companions from attempt failure and no-support nonproduction. |
| SCI-MAP-REQ-037 | Rationale: Observation coaddition; role-qualified atomic rule | Under a future accepted/activated profile, admit a complete observation atomically before mutation only at the selected role/family scope; permitted base-role response/covariance unavailability preserves signal membership. Current candidate evaluability and object decision are unavailable. |
| SCI-MAP-REQ-038 | Rationale: Observation coaddition; Units, WCS, products | Honor a preconstruction target grid and exact centered-integer embedding; give any later crop a new row-selected identity and reject other grid transforms. |
| SCI-MAP-REQ-039 | Rationale: Observation coaddition; coadd equations | If future activation and object admission occur, apply equal-observation arithmetic on exact rows identically for conforming in-memory and persisted bundles; empty coadd support produces no product or member. |
| SCI-MAP-REQ-040 | Rationale: Observation coaddition; response companion equation; role matrix | Keep base-coadd signal membership when response is unavailable; for `R_coadd,out^(R)=B_out T_obs^(R)`, require one exact same compatible family, fixed coadd state, and exact composition theorem; never treat a finite difference as a Jacobian; keep coadd-procedure/whole-chain unavailable. |
| SCI-MAP-REQ-041 | Rationale: Observation coaddition; covariance companion equation; role matrix | Require every named within/cross block for a covariance-qualified role; otherwise block only that stronger role while the base parent retains exact partial/symbolic/summarized/lineage-resolvable/unavailable state. Never infer zero or independence. |
| SCI-MAP-REQ-042 | Rationale: Observation coaddition; notation cleanup | Reject correlated GLS as a substitution for the ordinary positive-coefficient coadd; reserve `K_p` for response and use `bold Sigma^obs` for stacked observation covariance. |
| SCI-MAP-REQ-043 | Rationale: Units, WCS, products, and downstream use | Persist role/base-parent/membership and response-family identity, `SCI-MAP-FULL-PROCEDURE-COMPARISON-SPACE` where applicable, operator/coefficient/grid facts, every reached lifecycle stage, separate attempt outcome, product identity only when realized, and exact cause. |
| SCI-MAP-REQ-044 | Rationale: Units, WCS, products, and downstream use | Bind full AST frame/WCS and exact signal/beam units; reject name-based frame or beam equivalence. |
| SCI-MAP-REQ-045 | Rationale: Units, WCS, products and downstream use; WCS specification | Keep full-precision WCS authoritative and compare FITS/typed WCS over every preregistered addressable center and outer-boundary vertex/corner with the exact frame, metric, binary64 precision, invalid-point failure, orientation, and 0.1-arcsec finite-population bound. |
| SCI-MAP-REQ-046 | Rationale: Units, WCS, products, and downstream use; lifecycle and comparison records | Record each reached lifecycle stage, separate attempt/product/failure evidence, six profile axes, typed cut/no-support proof, role/parent/membership, response family/composition, coefficient handoff, operator, exposure, WCS, stable comparison record, and route without future-stage placeholders. |
| SCI-MAP-REQ-047 | Rationale: Units, WCS, products, and downstream use; failure table | Propagate each failure at its role-qualified scope and retain applied-attempt failure evidence without a product; distinguish `not_produced` empty support and base-bundle companion unavailability from failure. |
| SCI-MAP-REQ-048 | Rationale: Observation coaddition; publication block | Require the logical role-bound bundle only for an actual product with rows, enforce plan-required publication, preserve lifecycle/attempt/product distinctions and PTC duties, and never admit a no-row object as a coadd member. |
| SCI-MAP-REQ-049 | Rationale: Units, WCS, products, and downstream use | Preserve immutable base/unfiltered MAP identity, ordered membership, validity, lifecycle, and parentage through every stronger role and derivative product. |
| SCI-MAP-REQ-050 | Rationale: Units, WCS, products, and downstream use; NOI amendment | Supply the complete role-bound scientific bundle to consumers, retain every reached lifecycle stage and exact NOI claim distinctions, and let consumers declare stronger requirements without rewriting MAP. |
| SCI-MAP-REQ-051 | Rationale: Validation; fixed-operator discussion | Claim the same noise operator only when every operator-defining fact and row is fixed or identically prescribed. |
| SCI-MAP-REQ-052 | Rationale: Units, WCS, products, and downstream use; Owner decisions | Bound Pointing/OOF reuse to the exact operator and mode authority; reject method/claim promotion while preserving independent experimentation and versioned identity. |

Author-side completeness target: 52 unique contiguous requirement IDs appear
once in this table and once in `src/common/requirements.tex`. Mechanical
verification is recorded separately and does not establish conformance.
